lines.en: label chikaspecial45:
scene noonsky
I tap on Chika’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
I know she’s normally working around this time but, based on what may be a change of heart centered around a hopeful change in income...that might not be the case any longer.
I doubt she’s made any major moves yet. I feel like she would have told me if she did. Or, at the bare minimum, sent me a picture of her with at least part of the costume on.
She’s sent me nothing at all.
Which is why I’m now reaching out to her — so she can be reminded of what is important.
Me.
: Helloooo?
: Hey. Are you working right now?
: I am not! I took today off to hang out with Tsubasa.
: I see...Just to satisfy my own curiosity though, are you still employed by the clothing place? Or have you moved onto bigger, pinker things yet?
: I am still employed by the clothing place. I haven’t followed up with Uta yet. But if you’re that desperate to see me in the uniform, I can ask her if I can borrow one.
: That would be greatly appreciated. Is this thing with Tsubasa something I can join in on? Or are you two being a weird, unrelated mother-daughter couple again?
: You can drop by if you want! We’re at my place.
: Not sure how much fun you’ll have, though. We’re kind of just talking and making sure the kids don’t accidentally take over the world.
: I guess I’ll come meet you then. It’s not like I have anything else going on.
: Cool! I’ll let everybody know. I’m sure they’ll all be happy to see you.
: Doubtful.
: Oh, shut it. I love you and I’ll see you soon.
: Yeah...you too.
scene black
As you may have noticed, I’ve given up on fighting the boyfriend thing — even mentally.

I’ve waited too long at this point to say anything about it and, even if Chika only started believing it due to me not making my stance on relationships clear enough, I’m here now and...I don’t want to leave.
It’s by that metric, however, that I realize I’m dating a ton of people.
Some of them understand my stance a little better than others, sure- but when it comes down to it...I’m not really anything more than the student body’s universal boyfriend.
All that’s left to do is check off the rest of the boxes pertaining to those I haven’t slept with yet and further diminish the meaning of the word “boyfriend” until it's no longer worth it to anyone.
I’ll get there.
But before that, there’s somewhere else I need to go.
scene chikasflashback1
A place where I am always welcome — with paperthin walls and a foundation I’m sure is already in the process of crumbling.
Much like the rest of the buildings in this half of town, this one surely doesn’t have much time left.
I have somewhere else I could take her.
It’s a place that’s still a secret to most, and I could make it Chika’s secret as well if I was anywhere near a good person.
But I’m not.
And so I’ll wait for her new mother to do it instead because it will spare me a slightly difficult talk.
: Hey! You hungry? Tsubasa’s making curry.
: Look at me, cooking when it’s not even a competition. It’s like university all over again.
: I’m fine. You two can eat without me.
: Are you sure? We made enough for like ten people so there would be plenty of leftovers for tomorrow.
: Follow up with me tomorrow then. In the meantime, what are Chinami and Tsukasa arguing about? They look...passionate.
scene chikasflashback2
: Chinami! What’s Tsukasa trying to convince you to do now?!
: Chinami doesn’t even know! Tsukasa just keeps yelling letters at her!
: I’m trying to teach you the difference between CEO, CRO, CMO, CTO, CFO, COO, CSO, CHRO, and CIO! This is elementary level stuff, Chinami! You need to know this as my partner!
: See?!
: Yes! C! For Chief! Now, tell me what the other letters stand for!
scene chikasflashback3
: And that’s basically why we stopped paying attention.
: Oh, Tsukasa and her acronyms. I’m just glad she’s outgrown speaking entirely through abbreviations. That was quite a difficult month for me.
: Yeah, I’m good not taking any part in their conversation and will gladly just continue conversing with you two instead.
: So long as that doesn’t pertain to business as well, I mean. Because if you two are being anywhere near as boring as them, I’m out of here.
: I was actually just telling Tsubasa about my mom.
: Without crying?
scene chikasflashback4
: I don’t always cry when talking about her, you know. I have plenty of good memories to talk about too.
: Then why haven’t you ever told me about them?
: Becaaaaause it’s not an exciting conversation topic and we’re normally doing...other stuff?
: Well, I see there’s no need to fully censor yourself around Tsubasa anymore.
if chikalust25 == True:
scene chikasflashback5
: After what I saw during your Halloween party? No, there’s no need for such formalities anymore.
: Arf...
: Arf indeed.
else:
scene chikasflashback5
: To this day, I can no longer walk down the halls of the ryokan without hearing phantom noises that are quite similar to those you two made when you stayed there.
: Hahah...hah...
: I apologize for our actions somehow haunting your halls. But also, I regret nothing.
scene chikasflashback6
: Are you like, actually cool hearing about her though? It won’t be weird for you?
: Why would it be weird?
: I don’t know...You never really talk about your parents, so I figured there might be some hostility there or-
: There’s nothing. Just finish whatever story you were telling Tsubasa and I’ll fill in the gaps.
: You’re positive?
: I’m positive.
scene chikasflashback7
: Okay.
: Then...
scene black
scene chikasflashback8
: It was in this very kitchen...on curry night...
: Mom! Have you seen my bracelet anywhere?
: Which one, Chika? You have many, many bracelets.
: The one with the beads! That we got from the flea market near the beach!
scene chikasflashback9
: Didn’t you say you were going to take good care of that one? Taking care of something means not losing it, you know.
: I didn’t lose-
: Oh. Here it is.
scene chikasflashback10
: Told you I didn't lose it.
: It was in Chinami’s playpen. It must have fallen off when I was playing with her.
: Please be more careful around your sister, Chika. She’s at that age where she wants to put everything in her mouth and I’m pretty sure that bracelet isn’t edible.
scene chikasflashback11
: Do you know when she’s coming home?
: Why? Do you miss her?
: Not really. I’m just wondering.
: Are you just too embarrassed to admit you miss her?
scene chikasflashback12
: No. I already told you. I’m just wondering.
: She’s been gone for a while and I just want to know when she’ll be back. That’s all.
: Well, regardless of whether or not you’re embarrassed, which you are, I’m glad you’re “wondering.”
scene chikasflashback13
: It’s your job to look out for her, after all. And having a responsible girl like you as my backup takes a huge load off of my mind, Chika.
scene chikasflashback14
: Of course! You know I’d do anything I can to help! And I won’t even ask for a raise on my allowance in exchange!
: What do you want now?
: I don’t know what you’re talking about, Mommy. There isn’t anything I want. And if there is, it’s definitely not a gold necklace like yours.
: This isn’t real gold, Chika. How many times do I have to tell you that?
: Yeah, but it looks gold and I want to look more like you.
scene chikasflashback15
: Between your hair, your clothes, your attitude...you’re basically already me, Chika. A necklace isn’t going to bring you any closer.
: You know I don’t have any money to give you anyway.
: Can I at least use your makeup kit?
scene chikasflashback16
: Absolutely not and you are grounded for even asking.
: Pleeeeease? I’m almost nine years old. I should be allowed by now.
scene chikasflashback17
: Oh, my beautiful daughter...
: No.
: But why?!
: Because I said so.
: But Mom-
scene chikasflashback18
: In regard to the youngest member of the Chosokabe family, I estimate another...three hours until she’s back from her check-up at the hospital.
: That long? What are they even doing over there?
scene chikasflashback19
: Blood work. More tests to figure out what’s wrong so we can start making her better.
: Do they not have enough of her blood already? How much more do they need?
: I don’t know. Nobody does. But all we can do is keep listening to what the doctors say since they know better than us.
scene chikasflashback20
: I wish it was me instead.
: Chika-
: Why can’t they take my blood? We’re sisters. It’s the same, isn’t it?
scene chikasflashback21
: You know it doesn’t work that way. You’re smarter than this.
: Chinami’s special. Which means she needs special care.
: We can’t even go with her, though? Why do we have to stay here?
scene chikasflashback22
: Because it would only make things harder.
: If we go with her, we’ll get questioned. She looks just like us and we don’t have enough money for her tests.
: But people aren’t going to question your friend bringing her when they look nothing alike?
: Nope! Because my friend has connections at the hospital and has been pretending Chinami is her daughter for two years now.
: No one’s going to question her at this point...and we need her insurance.
: In fact, I doubt anyone would question her in general. She’s a little intimidating sometimes. But it’s better to be safe than sorry.
: It still feels weird...
scene chikasflashback23
: That’s because it’s extremely illegal! But sometimes, drastic measures must be taken to ensure that-
scene chikasflashback24
: Aghahhck!!! Mnnfghckkck! HMmf! Ngchghchkl!
: Mom?! Are you okay?!
scene chikasflashback25
: Mgh...fhmhckh....
: Purse...
: Which one?!
: The...knockoff Louis...
: I know that! I meant which medication?!
: In...haler...
: Okay!
scene black
: Okay! Okay! Okay!
: Hang in there! I’ve got it!
scene chikasflashback26
: She lasted a few more years after that.
: It probably could have been longer if we were wealthy but, that’s...just the hand you’re dealt sometimes.
: On the bright side, she got to keep all of her hair. And she died prettier than most people ever live.
: Oh, Chika...you poor thing.
: So much for happy memories. That was fucking miserable.
scene chikasflashback27
: It wasn’t, though.
: Like, yeah, the way it really ended was...but I learned so much from her. And if it weren’t for her teaching me all about responsibility, I have no idea where I’d even be today.
scene chikasflashback28
: In hindsight, it was pretty clear she knew she wasn’t going to last forever.
: In fact, I probably believed that back then as well but just chose to ignore it because I was too afraid.
: I think that’s why she was as strict with me as she was...why she always called me her “backup.”
: It was only a matter of time until it was my turn.
scene chikasflashback29
: It’s my turn now.
: But she’s still watching over me, wherever she is.
: And she can’t tell me I’m not allowed to use her makeup kit anymore.
scene chikasflashback30
: Sincerest apologies! I couldn’t hold back any longer!
: Hey! Hey, hey, hey! It’s okay! You don’t have to cry! That was a hopeful, happy ending! I’m okay now!
: Well, I’m not!
scene chikasflashback31
: Oh no! What will become of Chinami when Tsukasa’s mommy kills her big sister?!
: You can come live in my house. Your house sucks anyway.
: You can both come live with me right now!
scene chikasflashback32
: Yaaaaaay!
: Woah, no way! I couldn’t do that to you! That’d be, like...totally unfair!
: But it wasn’t unfair having me buy multiple phones for you?
: Don’t even think of putting that on the same level as this, Sensei!
: Let’s go kill pigs to celebrate!
: Okay! Chinami goes first!
scene chikasflashback33
: God your boobs are so fucking big.
: You can cry into them. It’s okay.
: Crying is...kind of the last thing I want to do right now.
scene chikasflashback34
: Hah...I can’t remember the last time I shed real tears and not just fake ones at all of those charity drives.
: Like I said...you don’t have to cry. I’m fine now.
scene chikasflashback35
: Chika, I was serious about what I said. There is plenty of room at the manor for both you and your sister.
: I know...and thanks, Tsubasa. Really. But I have more control over Chinami’s health while I’m here and...
scene chikasflashback36
: I think both of us still have a lot of...attachment to this place. I might have moved on and grown up, but...I don’t know if I’m ready to leave that behind just yet.
: Well, my offer will remain open indefinitely. And should you change your mind or require any assistance at all, please just let me know.
scene chikasflashback37
: Of course...thank you, Tsubasa.
: For everything.
scene black
I can’t help but feel like it may have been better if I didn’t come here today.
It was “nice” finally getting to hear more about Chika’s mother, don’t get me wrong-
But it seems to me like I may have interrupted a moment that would have just...been better without me.
While Tsubasa cried her eyes out and Chika did all she could to cheer her up, I kind of just...stood there.
I mean, what else was I supposed to do?
I couldn’t help.
I couldn’t relate.
My presence was nothing more than an unnecessary afterthought.
Which is why it feels so wrong to still be splashing around in puddles even after the rain subsides.
